rationale: V_rawplus is statistically credible and passes every statistical/methodology gate, including reproduction, threshold provenance, clean forward validation, and segment documentation. However, it cannot receive FULL certification because (1) the three fraud-rate features (user/merchant/city) remain UNVERIFIED for label availability, and (2) offline/production feature parity has not been verified in this gate. Per the brief, these open issues allow CONDITIONAL certification rather than FULL, and CONDITIONAL does NOT authorize production promotion.

final_test_note: FINAL_TEST_AUTHORIZED = FALSE. Even though forward evidence is acceptable, the label-latency and parity conditions are not resolved. A conditional certification may authorize the next controlled evaluation only if the unresolved condition does not invalidate the evaluation itself. Here, the unresolved label-availability condition directly affects the candidate production semantics and therefore should be resolved before any final-test adjudication. The historical Phase-6 one-shot (E 0.9967 / V 0.9908) remains the only existing final-test evidence and is preserved.
conditions_for_next_phase: Resolve label latency for user/merchant/city fraud-rate features (establish real label-availability timing from data/provenance) OR remove those features and re-verify the candidate frontier.

Complete offline-vs-production feature parity verification for all 48 features, including edge cases (zero amounts, NaN, missing strings, missing/unseen merchant/city/category, extreme values, malformed optional fields).
Verify production model-loading safety and online feature path for the exact 48-feature contract.
Compute PSI and alert-rate impact vs production reference before any promotion consideration.
Keep E_hardneg immutable as rollback baseline until and unless a fully certified candidate supersedes it via an authorized promotion path.
If certification is upgraded to FULL after the above, a single clean final-test one-shot at tV* = 0.0298937337 may be authorized by explicit decision; no further tuning may follow.
